hook: A Superhuman-style Gmail client, free and in Rust

beats.say: Miguel Piedrafita released Exo, a fast, local, native Gmail client for macOS inspired by Superhuman.
It is written in Rust with no Electron or web views, and talks to Gmail directly, with no third-party servers. It is free and open source.
To use it, you create your own free Google sign-in client, enabling the Gmail, Calendar and People APIs, then drop its file into Exo's folder. Exo ships as a disk image you drag into Applications.
